takes.h: Super7’s Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla ReAction two-pack arrives as a Ross exclusive
takes.p: The Toyark reports that Super7’s Godzilla ReAction Figure 2-Pack, part of its Epic Battle Series, pairs Godzilla and Mechagodzilla from the 1974 film Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla. The 3.75-inch-scale set was listed as available exclusively at Ross stores when The Toyark posted it on November 5.
